investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ironworks Trips (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure centralindia (zones centralindia-1/centralindia-2/centralindia-3); network range 10.64.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ironwo-prod-centra (AKS); Database: postgres instance itinerary-db-01 for itinerary-api; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
